files: REQUIRED: glob(s) to your SoLEXS files, e.g. /data/solexs/**/*.fits
sxr.long: REQUIRED: long-channel flux column (or [list of columns that are summed])
sxr.short: REQUIRED: short-channel flux column (or null if unavailable)

files: REQUIRED: glob(s) to your HEL1OS files
hxr.counts_lo: REQUIRED: low-band counts column (or [list of columns that are summed])
hxr.counts_hi: REQUIRED: high-band counts column (or [list of columns that are summed])
hxr.live_time: REQUIRED: live-time column (same time unit you want rates in)

catalog.file: REQUIRED: flare catalog file (onset, peak, end, class)
catalog.class: REQUIRED: class column (e.g. C2.3) -- or set to null and give peak_flux
